options.name: api_token
options.description: Nextcloud App Password. Can also be set as ENV variable.

options.name: enable
options.description: Wether a user should be enabled or disabled.

options.name: host
options.description: Nextcloud tld host. Can also be set as ENV variable.

options.name: ssl_mode
options.description: ability to use http:// for integration tests ability to skip ssl verification Possible values `https` (default https), `http` (http), `skip` (https)

options.name: user
options.description: Nextcloud user who (will) owns the file. Can also be set as ENV variable.

options.name: username
options.description: Nextcloud username to receive detail information. Nextcloud UserID
